messages:
Alex K: Quick sync — we need an incentive matrix for migrating appliance/private-offer customers to marketplace private offers. Goal: preserve committed ARR, keep legal/billing happy, include HW + SI credits. Need A/B/C options by Fri. Thoughts?
Maria G: +1. Two big constraints: marketplace SKUs don't map 1:1 to reserved GPU units, and private offers require Marketplace approval. Finance needs to ok commit recognition rules.
Chris P: Also model renewal cliffs — what happens at 12mo if usage drops. Need mapping from appliance SKUs -> marketplace SKUs and a revenue deferral plan.
Sophie L: From SI side: can offer implementation credit (example: 50% of first 3 months of SI fees) to accelerate migrations in Q2. That reduces friction for the customer.
Jon (partner-eng): HW partners want a co-sell rebate if they bundle hardware (up to 10%). They also need a clear SKU/line-item to attach to deals. Legal will want standard wording.
pricing-bot: Draft matrix CSV attached: 
```
tier,commit_min,marketplace_discount,migration_credit,si_credit,hw_rebate,max_total_credit
A,100000,10%,10%,30%,5%,30%
B,250000,15%,15%,40%,8%,30%
C,500000,20%,20%,50%,10%,30%
```
Alex K: That looks good as a starting point. Finance will want a cap on combined credits (suggest cap 30% total). Also set a commit minimum to avoid tiny deals gaming credits.
Maria G: Agreed on cap. Suggest commit min $100k ARR to qualify. I'll loop in Kate from finance.
Chris P: We should define operational guardrails: 90-day migration SLA, pro-rated credit if migration doesn't complete, and a fallback to Dedicated credits if marketplace move blocked.
Sophie L: For joint announcements: SI + HW logos only after customer signs marketing release. Proposed announcement target: 6 weeks after go-live.
Jon (partner-eng): Note: private offers that go below marketplace floor need Marketplace team approval — will add that as an approval step. Also, HW partner rebates must be claimable within 60 days of invoice.
Alex K: Action items: Maria -> finance owner; Chris -> net revenue model; Sophie -> draft SI credit T&Cs; Jon -> confirm HW rebate wording + legal path. Please reply with owners.
Maria G: I can own finance coordination (will ping Kate).
Chris P: I'll build the net revenue model. Need historical usage + billing mapping from eng-infra/SRE.
Sophie L: I'll draft the SI credit T&Cs by Wed. Will include clawback if customer churns <90 days.
Jon (partner-eng): I'll coordinate with HW PM (Liam) and legal to get rebate contract language.
Alex K: Also propose a fallback path: if Marketplace conversion blocked, offer a 6-month Dedicated credit with a convert-by clause.
pricing-bot: FYI: proposed cap formula = min(30%, sum(commit_credit,migration_credit,si_credit,hw_rebate)).
Maria G: Sounds fine. Please populate the shared spreadsheet and set decision_by = Fri 12pm PT.
Chris P: I'll drop first-pass model into the sheet by Thu EOD.
Sophie L: Any objections to the 50% SI credit in Tier A? Feels high if we combine with migration credits.
Jon (partner-eng): Suggest tiered SI credits: 50% for >$250k, 30% for 100–250k, 15% <100k.
Alex K: Good suggestion — let's use tiering. Reconvene Thu 11am for a 20-min sync to finalize. :calendar: 
Maria G: Confirmed Thu 11am.
Chris P: See you then.
Sophie L: OK.
Jon (partner-eng): I'll invite HW PM and legal to Thu sync.
Alex K: Thanks everyone — aim to lock matrix Fri.
